name: item_table
note: Item records, 0x4c bytes, ids 0-381, resident in the executable's data. See types.h Item.

name: class_min_stats
note: 6 stat minimums per class, 14 classes, checked by class change.

name: class_alignment
note: [alignment][class]: the class number if the alignment may take it, -1 if not (3 x 14).

name: exp_tables
note: 7 EXP tables of 13 u32: EXP for levels 2-13, then the step per level past 13.

name: exp_table_index
note: [race][class] -> which of the 7 EXP tables (11 x 14 bytes).

name: monster_records
note: Battle: the monster record of group g (1-4) at +(g-1)*0xd0, copied from the M_DT file's last 0xd0 bytes. Code reads +0xa8 as 0x8008a9c0 + g*0xd0. Group 7's would be at 0x8008af08 (inferred).

name: roster_snapshot
note: Copies all 20 roster records into 0x90-byte images at 0x80086880 (fields +0x00-0x7d, kills, deaths, and the ten bytes from +0xc5). MCARD's save code reads them (F). seed.csv's party_copy_build at 0x80020bd0 is a point inside this function.

name: equip_one
note: Equips one item: sets 0x2000; also 0x8000 (cursed) if the item's alignment bits exclude the wearer or its specials bit 7 is set. Returns 1 can't, 2 cursed.

name: item_restricted
note: 1 if the character can't equip the item: class, race or sex bits (alignment only curses). Copies: MAZE 0x800de470, HAZURE 0x800bb4dc.

name: item_restricted
note: Same test as JOUKA's item_restricted.

name: item_restricted
note: Same test as JOUKA's item_restricted (same field reads).

name: equip_menu
note: Equip command: unequips all but cursed items, then one pass per slot (main, sub, armor, helm, gauntlets, boots, other); then runs Item.equip_effect for equipped items that have one. Copies: MAZE 0x800daa1c, HAZURE 0x800afa9c.

name: equip_menu
note: Copy of JOUKA's equip_menu.

name: equip_menu
note: Copy of JOUKA's equip_menu (same field use).

name: ac_calc
note: AC = Roster.ac less party spell bonuses, clamped -99..99.

name: status_draw
note: Status screen fields: name, level, race, age, sex, alignment, class, the six stats, AC, deaths, status (highest bit), HP, gold, kills, EXP.

name: status_items_draw
note: Pack list; shows uses left for potions and scrolls (subtypes 0x14-0x15), not for item 0x143.

name: status_marks_draw
note: Emblems beside the name from Roster.marks.

name: item_inspect
note: Boltac's item detail: alignment, sex, class and race bits, AC or the weapon's Main/Sub/2-hand bits.

name: catalog_item_card
note: Catalog item page: the same restriction bits as icons; AC for armor.

name: roster_clear
note: Clears a roster record's name, race, status, age, stats, gold, pack, EXP, level, HP and location. Copies: BATTLE 0x800c574c, JOUKA 0x800dccc4, HAZURE 0x800be6e4.

name: item_use_break
note: Rolls Item.break_chance on use and turns the item into Item.break_into.

name: maze_step_hp
note: Per step: poison takes Roster.poison HP (1 in 4), regen adds Roster.regen (1 in 4).
